name: InstaGridMaker
tagline: InstaGridMaker – Split one photo into a seamless 3:4 Instagram grid
description: InstaGridMaker splits one photo into a seamless three-column Instagram profile grid of 1 to 6 rows, with 1080 × 1440 (3:4), 4:5 or square tiles numbered in posting order and saved as one ZIP. It runs entirely in your browser, so photos are never uploaded, and single-photo grids are free with no sign-up and no watermark. Pro ($9.99/mo or $99/yr) and Lifetime ($149 once) add batches of up to 50 photos, your own watermark and 200 on-device AI upscales a month.
